question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT rac.year, r.constructor_id, SUM(r.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races rac ON r.race_id = rac.race_id
    WHERE rac.year >= 2001 AND r.points IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rac.year, r.constructor_id
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(constructor_total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.year) as years_with_ties
FROM constructor_points cp
JOIN min_points_per_year mpy ON cp.year = mpy.year AND cp.constructor_total_points = mpy.min_points
GROUP BY cp.year
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
